newsitem.title: USA: USDA - net soymeal sales to China down in Jan 30 wk.
newsitem.headline: USDA - net soymeal sales to China down in Jan 30 wk.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Thursday net soymeal sales to China in the week ended Jan 30 were down 48,000 tonnes.
In its weekly export sales report, USDA said China soymeal activity in the week included 5,000 tonnes in new sales and 53,000 tonnes in foreign purchases and cancellations.

It also said net U.S. soybean sales in the week ended Jan 30 included reductions of 50,000 tonnes in optional origin sales because origins other than the United States were declared for sales to China.
